blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— Eleven short horror films by local filmmakers will be shown at the 15th Lilia Cuntapay Short Horror Film Festival on Oct. 30 at the La Paz Sand Dunes in Laoag City, Ilocos Norte. The screening, scheduled for 8 p.m., will showcase Ilokano storytelling through horror films inspired by the filmography of the late veteran horror actress Lilia Cuntapay. The films will be a range of horror stories, including those drawn from local folklore, highlighting Ilokano filmmakers’ creativity and their contributions to regional cinema.
